The '''''Atrivis Advancer''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owned by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Flinor Tekkirl]]. A [[Pathfinder-class scout ship|Pathfinder]] model manufactured by [[Vangaard Industries]], the starship remained unmodified by the scout.<ref name="CRO" /> At thirty-six [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the [[Scout ship/Legends|scout ship]] was equipped with a single [[Turret/Legends|turret]]-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] and could attain speeds of 950 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. It was [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped, with a Class 3 as primary, and a Class 15 as backup,<ref name="GG8" /> enabling Tekkirl to use it in his various scouting missions to unexplored and dangerous regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Bill Smith]] created the ''Atrivis Advancer'' for the [[West End Games]] sourcebook ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', published in [[1994]], where it received a brief mention among the items in Flinor Tekkirl's equipment list. The book specified that the starship remained in stock condition, and directed the reader to the statistics for the Vangaard pathfinder contained within ''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]'', written by Smith and [[Bill Olmesdahl]] and published in [[1993]].
